pages.lesson:
LESSON: HADITH ON KNOWLEDGE

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Hadith 2.1 Hadith on good Behaviour (3 Lessons) By the end of the sub - strand, 
Topic 2.3: Hadith on Knowledge

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Hadith on Knowledge. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: Why is it important to seek knowledge in Islam?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. read the Hadith as a source of reference in seeking knowledge

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. read the Hadith as a source of reference in seeking knowledge
   In simple words: practise until you can read the Hadith as a source of reference in seeking knowledge. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Hadith on Knowledge using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Hadith on Knowledge in the examples.
2. Explain Hadith on Knowledge to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Hadith on Knowledge.
4. Show that you can: read the Hadith as a source of reference in seeking knowledge

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Hadith on Knowledge using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Hadith on Knowledge important for a Grade 5 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Read from a chart/digital devices the Hadith on knowledge: “Seeking knowledge is obligatory upon every Muslim.” (Al-Tirmidhi),
2. Discuss ways of improving academic performance in school,
3. Critical thinking and problem solving: the skill of interpretation and inference as learners proactively discuss ways of improving academic performance in their school.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why is it important to seek knowledge in Islam?
2. What challenges may hinder one from acquiring education?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. read the Hadith as a source of reference in seeking knowledge

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
